domain: z>0; real 0<eps<1, locally holomorphic kernels near eps=0
summation_order: finite a,b,c,d and h sums are completed for each k,l before the absolutely convergent k,l sum

p(k,a,b,z).expression: Sum((-1)**h*z**(-a - b + h + k)*(z + 1)**(h - k)*factorial(k)/(factorial(h)*factorial(a - h)*factorial(b - h)*factorial(-a - b + h + k)), (h, Max(0, a + b - k), Min(a, b)))
p(k,a,b,z).latex: \sum_{h=\max\left(0, a + b - k\right)}^{\min\left(a, b\right)} \frac{\left(-1\right)^{h} z^{- a - b + h + k} \left(z + 1\right)^{h - k} k!}{h! \left(a - h\right)! \left(b - h\right)! \left(- a - b + h + k\right)!}

F_base(eps,z).expression: ((z + 1)**2/z)**eps*Sum(RisingFactorial(1 - eps, k)*RisingFactorial(1 - eps, l)*Sum(p(k, a, b, z)*p(l, c, d, z)/((a + 1)*(b + 1)*(a + c + 2)*(b + d + 2)), (a, 0, k), (b, 0, k), (c, 0, l), (d, 0, l))/(factorial(k)*factorial(l)), (k, 0, oo), (l, 0, oo))
F_base(eps,z).latex: \left(\frac{\left(z + 1\right)^{2}}{z}\right)^{\varepsilon} \sum_{\substack{0 \leq k \leq \infty\\0 \leq l \leq \infty}} \frac{{\left(1 - \varepsilon\right)}^{\left(k\right)} {\left(1 - \varepsilon\right)}^{\left(l\right)} \sum_{\substack{0 \leq a \leq k\\0 \leq b \leq k\\0 \leq c \leq l\\0 \leq d \leq l}} \frac{p{\left(k,a,b,z \right)} p{\left(l,c,d,z \right)}}{\left(a + 1\right) \left(b + 1\right) \left(a + c + 2\right) \left(b + d + 2\right)}}{k! l!}

F_id_after(eps,z).expression: ((z + 1)**2/z)**eps*Sum(RisingFactorial(1 - eps, k)*RisingFactorial(1 - eps, l)*Sum(p(k, a, b, z)*p(l, c, d, z)/((a + 1)*(b + 1)*(a + c + 2)*(b + d + 2)*(b + d + eps + 2)), (a, 0, k), (b, 0, k), (c, 0, l), (d, 0, l))/(factorial(k)*factorial(l)), (k, 0, oo), (l, 0, oo))
F_id_after(eps,z).latex: \left(\frac{\left(z + 1\right)^{2}}{z}\right)^{\varepsilon} \sum_{\substack{0 \leq k \leq \infty\\0 \leq l \leq \infty}} \frac{{\left(1 - \varepsilon\right)}^{\left(k\right)} {\left(1 - \varepsilon\right)}^{\left(l\right)} \sum_{\substack{0 \leq a \leq k\\0 \leq b \leq k\\0 \leq c \leq l\\0 \leq d \leq l}} \frac{p{\left(k,a,b,z \right)} p{\left(l,c,d,z \right)}}{\left(a + 1\right) \left(b + 1\right) \left(a + c + 2\right) \left(b + d + 2\right) \left(b + d + \varepsilon + 2\right)}}{k! l!}

F_id_middle(eps,z).expression: ((z + 1)**2/z)**eps*Sum(RisingFactorial(1 - eps, k)*RisingFactorial(1 - eps, l)*Sum(p(k, a, b, z)*p(l, c, d, z)/((a + 1)*(b + 1)*(a + c + 2)*(b + eps + 1)*(b + d + eps + 2)), (a, 0, k), (b, 0, k), (c, 0, l), (d, 0, l))/(factorial(k)*factorial(l)), (k, 0, oo), (l, 0, oo))
F_id_middle(eps,z).latex: \left(\frac{\left(z + 1\right)^{2}}{z}\right)^{\varepsilon} \sum_{\substack{0 \leq k \leq \infty\\0 \leq l \leq \infty}} \frac{{\left(1 - \varepsilon\right)}^{\left(k\right)} {\left(1 - \varepsilon\right)}^{\left(l\right)} \sum_{\substack{0 \leq a \leq k\\0 \leq b \leq k\\0 \leq c \leq l\\0 \leq d \leq l}} \frac{p{\left(k,a,b,z \right)} p{\left(l,c,d,z \right)}}{\left(a + 1\right) \left(b + 1\right) \left(a + c + 2\right) \left(b + \varepsilon + 1\right) \left(b + d + \varepsilon + 2\right)}}{k! l!}

F_swap_after(eps,z).expression: ((z + 1)**2/z)**eps*Sum(RisingFactorial(1 - eps, k)*RisingFactorial(1 - eps, l)*Sum(p(k, a, b, z)*p(l, c, d, z)/((a + 1)*(d + 1)*(a + c + 2)*(b + d + 2)*(b + d + eps + 2)), (a, 0, k), (b, 0, k), (c, 0, l), (d, 0, l))/(factorial(k)*factorial(l)), (k, 0, oo), (l, 0, oo))
F_swap_after(eps,z).latex: \left(\frac{\left(z + 1\right)^{2}}{z}\right)^{\varepsilon} \sum_{\substack{0 \leq k \leq \infty\\0 \leq l \leq \infty}} \frac{{\left(1 - \varepsilon\right)}^{\left(k\right)} {\left(1 - \varepsilon\right)}^{\left(l\right)} \sum_{\substack{0 \leq a \leq k\\0 \leq b \leq k\\0 \leq c \leq l\\0 \leq d \leq l}} \frac{p{\left(k,a,b,z \right)} p{\left(l,c,d,z \right)}}{\left(a + 1\right) \left(d + 1\right) \left(a + c + 2\right) \left(b + d + 2\right) \left(b + d + \varepsilon + 2\right)}}{k! l!}
